user.title: Heart, vitals and body
user.description: Choose whose health data to use. Supported source: Life Dashboard.

data_description.name: Used for the device and its entities, for example a person's name.
data_description.source_entry: The integration entry that receives this person's health data.
data_description.birth_year: Used only to pick the VO2 max benchmark for your age. Without it, the benchmark for ages 40 to 49 is used.
data_description.sex: Used only to pick the VO2 max benchmark. Without it, the mean of the benchmarks for men and women is used.

error.not_a_source: This entry does not belong to a supported integration.
error.no_heart_rate: This entry has no heart rate sensor. Send health data to it first, or enable its heart rate sensor.
error.invalid_person: The year of birth or the sex is not a value that can be used.
error.invalid_name: Give a name of 1 to 60 characters.

abort.already_configured: This health data is already set up.
abort.no_source: No supported health integration is set up yet. Install and set up Life Dashboard first.
